acquisition method: MS data were acquired with a shotgun proteomics method
alkylation reagent: protein reduction (10 mM TCEP) and alkylation (50 mM CAA) were performed
alkylation concentration: protein reduction (10 mM TCEP) and alkylation (50 mM CAA) were performed
cleavage agent: The first digestion was done at 37 °C for 2 h with LysC... The second digestion step was done using fresh LysC (1:50 enzyme to protein ratio) and trypsin (1:20 enzyme to protein ratio)
collision energy: Precursors were fragmented by higher-energy collisional dissociation with normalized collision energy of 25%
fractionation method: We previously developed the quantitative detergent solubility profiling (QDSP) method to add an additional dimension of protein solubility to tissue proteomes.
fragmentation method: Precursors were fragmented by higher-energy collisional dissociation with normalized collision energy of 25%
instrument: Mass spectrometry data were acquired on a Quadrupole/Orbitrap type Mass Spectrometer (Q-Exactive, Thermo Scientific)
labeling: For label-free quantification in MaxQuant the minimum ratio count was set to two.
